topics.title: Anthropic just filed to go public
topics.why: Anthropic filed its S-1 with the SEC on Oct 26, aiming to list on Nasdaq under ticker "ANT" in what could be one of the largest tech IPOs ever — a sign the AI boom is about to face public-market scrutiny.

topics.title: AI-driven layoffs just crossed 196,000 for the year
topics.why: Trackers now count over 196,000 tech jobs cut in 2026, with more than half tied to AI-driven restructuring at companies like Oracle, Amazon, and Meta — hard numbers behind the "AI is already reshaping headcount" conversation.

topics.title: xAI's Grok Voice 3.0 just got dramatically faster
topics.why: xAI shipped Grok Voice 3.0, a speech-to-speech model claiming sub-1-second latency and the top score on a major voice benchmark, and switched its entire API over to it overnight — voice agents just got cheaper and faster to build.
